author: mmarriot
body:
#### PR description:

This adds `SimpleFlatTableProducer` plugins for four RECO types, so these collections can be written to NanoAOD
from RECO or AOD with configuration only:

- `SimplePFClusterFlatTableProducer` (`reco::PFCluster`)
- `SimpleGsfElectronFlatTableProducer` (`reco::GsfElectron`)
- `SimplePhotonFlatTableProducer` (`reco::Photon`)
- `SimpleMuonFlatTableProducer` (`reco::Muon`)

Today only the PAT versions exist for electrons, photons and muons, and there is nothing for PF clusters.
`SimpleCandidateFlatTableProducer` with `lazyEval` can reach type-specific methods, but PF clusters are not
candidates, and a typed producer resolves each expression once rather than for every object.

Nothing in the release uses them yet, so no changes are expected.

#### PR validation:

Ran all four on Phase-2 ttbar RECO (0 and 200 pileup) and on Run 3 data RECO: every column matches a direct FWLite
read of the same objects. `code-checks`, `code-format` and the unit tests are clean.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport.
title: Add simple flat table producers for RECO PF clusters, GSF electrons, photons and muons
